issues.where: the central arches and rising foreground wave
issues.what: After the close flyer clears, the opening settles into nearly the same rock-and-sky view. The swell and spray build, but neither produces a distinct reveal or payoff.
issues.fix: Make the rising swell culminate in one unmistakable breaker against the left spire before the opening ends.

issues.where: the flyers across the center sky
issues.what: The sea and giant stone shapes read immediately, but most of the flyers are tiny marks. The first frame does not give the eye one clear living subject to follow.
issues.fix: Bring one readable winged silhouette into the bright gap in the opening frame, then let it lead into the close flyby.
